summary: SB Drive Access ADMIN dashboard (iter 274) — fully tested both backend (6/6 pytest) and frontend UI flows. All 5 admin tabs (Dashboard, Catégories, Réglages/Safe Ride Night, Chauffeurs, Réservations) load and persist correctly. Category CRUD, SRN configurable hours/zones/modes, driver certify/revoke all working end-to-end with toasts and persistence after reload.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminAccess.js is 324 lines — well structured with sub-components (Dashboard/Categories/Settings/Drivers/Bookings), no DRY violations spotted.
Settings save payload correctly serializes start_hour/end_hour as numbers and forwards modes/zones arrays — verified persistence works.
ScopeEditor reused for category scope, available_zones, and SRN zones — good reuse.
Minor: Stats Dashboard component shows 7 stat tiles in grid-cols-4 — last row has 3 tiles only (aesthetic only, not a bug).
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_access_iter274 category during pytest then deleted; created TEST_access_ui_274 via UI then deleted. SRN modified to start=21/end=5 with FR-Paris and FR-Lyon zones then RESTORED to defaults (start=20/end=6, modes=[access,standard], no zones).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All admin endpoints under /access/admin verified. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter274_access_admin.py covers stats, categories CRUD with persistence checks, settings GET/PUT including SRN configurability and available zones, driver certify+revoke cycle, bookings list. Frontend admin route /admin/access fully functional. NOTE: Playwright tab navigation requires ~3s wait after click before querying rendered rows — the accessAPI calls take time to resolve.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no issues found. Initial Playwright run showed CATEGORIES rows=0 and empty Bookings tbody but this was because query_selector_all ran before the GET /access/admin/categories and /bookings network responses returned. Re-test with 3s wait_for_timeout after tab click correctly showed 3 categories and 4 bookings — matches backend (curl-verified). Not a bug.
